backend/main.mo: Defines the backend actor with user, ritual, quiz, challenge, and stats types plus storage and authorization mixins.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report listing the Version 66 reset verification feature, related files, components, and test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Pre-written summaries of multiple frontend files describing UI components, pages, hooks, and styling.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind base and theme variable definitions for light and dark modes with color tokens and global styling.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point including metadata, icons, and a pre-React theme initialization script to prevent theme flash.
frontend/QA_ACCEPTANCE_CHECKLIST.md: QA checklist for Version 66 reset verification with build stability, feature verification, and historical checklists.
frontend/QA_VERSION_66_RESET_REPORT.md: Report confirming Version 66 workspace restore with pass results for draft label display, build stability, and feature verification.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Main app component that manages authentication, profile loading states, navigation between tabs, and conditionally renders landing, profile setup, or page content.
frontend/src/components/BottomNav.tsx: Renders a fixed bottom navigation bar with tab icons and labels, highlighting and switching the active tab.
frontend/src/components/CompletionAnimat: Displays an animated floating hearts effect using randomized positions and delays.
frontend/src/components/DataStates.tsx: Provides reusable UI components for loading, empty, error, section headers, and inline loading states.
frontend/src/components/HarmonyBreakdown: Shows current harmony score, 7‑day trend visualization, and breakdown with conditional explanations and data checks.
Compact harmony summary button showing score and trend, used for navigation to insights.
frontend/src/components/LandingBrand.tsx: Displays the GrowInLove brand logo with fallback text styling if the image fails to load.
frontend/src/components/LandingFooterLin: Dialog that renders About, Contact, Terms, Privacy, or Investor informational content based on selected option.
frontend/src/components/LandingHeroScree: Displays a phone mockup that cycles through landing screenshots with dot indicators and a selectable index.
Shows a preview or full version of the founder story with a toggle button to expand or collapse content.
frontend/src/components/LandingScreensho: A rotating screenshot carousel with navigation buttons, auto-advance, and dot indicators inside a phone mockup.
frontend/src/components/LoginButton.tsx: Handles login/logout using Internet Identity with status handling, UI states, and cache clearing on logout.
frontend/src/components/LoveChallenges.t: Placeholder card announcing upcoming love challenges with decorative icons.
frontend/src/components/OurLoveLanguages: Interactive card showing love language status with primary and secondary actions and optional highlight animation.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetup.tsx: Profile setup form that collects a user's name, submits it, and displays success or error feedback.
frontend/src/components/RewardVisuals.ts: Displays placeholder progress and milestone visuals including a heart-shaped progress meter.
frontend/src/components/SpinWheel.tsx: Interactive spinning wheel selecting a love language, with animations, localStorage persistence, and daily limits.
frontend/src/components/ThemeToggle.tsx: Toggle button that switches between light and dark themes using context and shows corresponding icons.
frontend/src/components/UnlockPacks.tsx: Displays unlockable activity packs based on love language, streak progress, and quiz completion, allowing pack selection.
frontend/src/config/draftBuildLabel.ts: Returns a fixed draft build label string for preview identification.
frontend/src/content/contact.ts: Exports the app’s contact email address.
frontend/src/content/founderStory.ts: Provides the full founder story text as a long multiline string.
Exports screenshot metadata for landing page images and captions.
frontend/src/contexts/ThemeContext.tsx: Implements theme context with system detection, persistence, and toggle logic for light and dark modes.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: Creates and manages a backend actor tied to Internet Identity, refetching dependent queries on identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: Provides Internet Identity login, logout, and identity management using Dfinity AuthClient.
frontend/src/hooks/usePrefersReducedMoti: Detects the user's reduced‑motion preference via a media query.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: Collection of React Query hooks for user profiles, admin checks, rituals, photos, and related backend calls.
frontend/src/hooks/useSectionEntrance.ts: Uses IntersectionObserver to reveal sections on scroll unless reduced‑motion is preferred.
frontend/src/hooks/useTheme.ts: Re‑exports the useTheme hook from ThemeContext for compatibility.
frontend/src/index.css: Defines Tailwind layers, CSS variables for light and dark romantic themes, utility classes, and animations.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Bootstraps the React app with React Query and Internet Identity provider before rendering App.
frontend/src/pages/Activities.tsx: Renders the Activities page with pairing/auth checks, challenges, rewards, and a spin wheel, including admin overrides.
frontend/src/pages/Home.tsx: Implements the daily ritual workflow with history, inputs, uploads, and animations driven by backend data.
frontend/src/pages/Insights.tsx: Displays relationship insights including streaks, harmony metrics, trends, and milestone badges based on backend stats.
frontend/src/pages/Landing.tsx: Builds the marketing landing page with animated sections, login flow, feature highlights, and screenshots.
frontend/src/pages/LoveLanguages.tsx: Renders the Love Languages quiz UI, maps quiz answers to backend enums, and manages quiz state, saving, and results.
frontend/src/pages/Memories.tsx: Displays ritual history entries with expandable details, date formatting, love‑language labels, and photo‑enabled responses.
frontend/src/pages/Us.tsx: Handles user pairing flow, admin checks, profile state, and displays shared insights like combined love‑language results.
frontend/src/utils/harmony.ts: Provides helpers for normalizing harmony trend data and producing percent values and trend labels.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Utilities for reading, persisting, and clearing URL or session parameters, including hash‑based routing support.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind configuration defining theme colors, fonts, animations, and content paths for the frontend build.
project_state.json: Project metadata describing state, issues, feature requests, and build‑restore requirements.
